# The suite's photograph

`pear.jpg` is "Rocha Pear 2017 C1" by Fructibus, from Wikimedia Commons,
<https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Rocha_Pear_2017_C1.jpg>, released
under CC0 1.0, the public domain dedication. Commons' 960 pixel copy was
brought down to 640 by 640 with a Lanczos filter and saved at quality 90.

`pear_mask.png` is made from it by `make_pear_mask.py` beside it, and is
under the same dedication.
